description: Source code for file packing and unpacking functions, including packing multiple files into a single archive and extracting them, with functions for dumping header info.

methods.name: pack_files
methods.description: Creates a packed archive from an array of file paths, returning a header structure.

methods.name: unpack_files
methods.description: Extracts files from a packed archive based on the provided header structure.

methods.name: dump_pack_hdr
methods.description: Prints details of the pack header and contained files.
